name: Progus Subscriptions
description: Progus Subscriptions lets you run your Shopify store's subscriptions straight from Claude. Once you connect your store, Claude can show your subscription analytics (MRR, churn, revenue, upcoming orders), browse and inspect subscription contracts, plans and subscribers, and take action: pause, resume, cancel or reschedule subscriptions, change item quantities, and email customers a payment-update link to recover failed payments. You can also set up subscriptions in bulk - find products in your catalog and create, update or remove subscription plans across many products at once. Read-only insights and everyday support actions are fast in chat, while irreversible actions (cancel, delete) ask for confirmation. The connector works on top of the Progus Subscriptions Shopify app and acts only on the store you authorize.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Progus Subscriptions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Progus Subscriptions to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://subscriptions.mcp.progus.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Progus Subscriptions MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Progus Subscriptions lists 19 MCP tools, including cancel_subscription, create_plans, delete_plans, get_analytics, get_analytics_summary, get_subscriber, get_subscription, list_plans, list_subscribers, list_subscriptions, list_upcoming_orders, and pause_subscription.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Progus Subscriptions?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Progus Subscriptions in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Progus Subscriptions MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Progus Subscriptions requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Progus Subscriptions is developed by Progus. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
